commands.result: Passed in /private/tmp/t055-qualified.log: 301 Rust tests plus one doc test, 654 Python, 259 web, 51 installed-worker tests; 44 document, 27 safety and 12 Rust-boundary regressions.
Final nine tests passed in 2.40 seconds after tightening grace for descendants with closed log descriptors; /private/tmp/t055-final-supervision.log.
18 installed-worker discovery tests passed, including nonce failure before import and coordinator disconnect during import.

coverage: Simultaneous stdout/stderr floods exceed 4 MiB per stream while 4096-byte retention caps preserve explicit markers and exact raw observed counts.
Crash, startup crash, nonzero exit and worker error retain both streams; real child exit is required independently of completed frames.
Wrong nonce, session and major; malformed, oversized and partial frames; missing hello; wrong/regressing phases; missing/duplicate results and post-terminal frames fail closed.
Partial framing and startup silence obey absolute caller deadlines; heartbeat silence alone remains a diagnostic.
Split known credential and nonce redaction, split sensitive headers, binary bytes, private request/log modes, create-new/no-follow log paths and request/log policy bounds.
Dropped async receiver cancels a TERM-resistant child group, reaps the leader and preserves logs; normal completion cleans descendants, including full grace after descendants close stdout/stderr.
Discovery reuses the shared owner and keeps public JSON output isolated from imports. Existing CLI integration journeys pass.
corrected_failures: Sandbox-only socket attempts returned I/O failures; authorized native runs were used for actual qualification.
Darwin zombie-only process groups returned EPERM. Cleanup now checks bounded OS process-state evidence before accepting this special case; live-group permission failures are not suppressed.
Specification task closure initially lacked required Verified on fields; dated owner evidence was added.
Python lint found one long test-source literal; the literal was split without changing behavior.
approval_review: A proposed fixture moving a child into its parent process group was rejected before execution. That case was removed; all qualified signal tests remain inside freshly isolated worker groups.
limits: Only macOS arm64 executed locally; Linux x86-64/arm64 qualification is left to the existing CI matrix and owner monitoring.
T056 retains admission, workspace configuration composition and independent execution/validation timers; T057/T066 retain persisted process identity, publication races and restart recovery.
Trusted code can escape process groups; process isolation is not hostile-code containment. Inherited escaped log descriptors have a bounded final drain with incomplete evidence.
Private persistent logs are a service API; public log inspection and durable attempt/event persistence remain later tasks.
Known-value/header redaction does not identify arbitrary transformed secrets. No new dependency, authored/generated schema, protocol or database version.
